subject: Competitive bake-off recap: NovaNet evaluation (Redwood vs CloudGen/InferX)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Liu <sophie.liu@novanet.com>, Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@novanet.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Competitive bake-off recap: NovaNet evaluation (Redwood vs CloudGen/InferX)

Hi Sophie / Carlos 

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and the bake-off conversation, plus proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Key pain points you confirmed:
- Current vendor (CloudGen) has intermittent latency spikes on peak inference traffic (3-4x above target).
- Cost unpredictability from token-based surges and poor batching with your prompt patterns.
- Need for tighter audit logs and data residency for PHI-sensitive inference pipelines.

Primary goals for the evaluation:
1) Consistently hit 150ms p95 on 2k qps baseline for short-response models (customer service use case).
2) Reduce inference unit cost by ~30% vs current (measured tokens + infra).
3) Demonstrate private VPC deployment option and end-to-end auditability for HIPAA scope.

What we discussed re: vendor comparison:
- Redwood strengths: serving runtime with continuous batching + KV prefix caching, model variant routing (low-cost fallbacks), and Private (VPC) deployment with KMS integration.
- CloudGen: currently better integrated with NovaNet infra but has had the spikes we discussed.
- InferX (third party in bake-off): performed okay on single-node latency but lacked adequate logging and multi-region routing.

Open questions to resolve during POC:
- Which specific endpoints (model and route) should we use for p95/throughput tests? (Sophie, can you confirm the 3 production intents?)
- Exact data residency/retention policy you need for audit logs (retention period + log export format).
- Procurement timeline and any legal review milestones (Carlos / Procurement).

Proposed next steps (agreed on call):
- NovaNet to share a short requirements spreadsheet with intents and example prompt distributions (Attachment: nova_requirements.xlsx). Please include peak qps windows.
- Redwood to deliver a POC test plan and performance baseline within 3 business days (we'll run both hosted and Private VPC scenarios).
- Schedule a 90-minute POC kickoff next Tue (May 26) to align infra and test harness  Connor to own infra setup.
- Procurement/Legal: Carlos, please share redlines or timing constraints.

Attachments: nova_requirements.xlsx (your action), Redwood preliminary perf summary (we'll attach after initial test).

If that aligns, I'll send calendar invites for the POC kickoff and Connor will send a PoC playbook.

Thanks  looking forward to working together.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai 
+1 (415) 555-0104

From: Sophie Liu <sophie.liu@novanet.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Competitive bake-off recap: NovaNet evaluation (Redwood vs CloudGen/InferX)

Thanks Aditya  this is great and captures the call. A few quick clarifications: 

- The three production intents are: 1) customer-chat-short (avg 12 tokens), 2) billing-inquiry (avg 48 tokens), 3) refund-flow (avg 30 tokens). We'll include example prompts in the spreadsheet.
- Retention: audit logs for inference metadata (timestamp, model, route, request-id) must be stored for 365 days and exportable as newline-delimited JSON.
- For procurement: target decision date is June 18, 2026  procurement will want a summary SOW and an initial cost estimate by June 4.

I'll upload the requirements sheet by EOD today. Looking forward to the kickoff.

 Sophie
Sophie Liu
Director of Platform Engineering | NovaNet
sophie.liu@novanet.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 11:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Competitive bake-off recap: NovaNet evaluation (POC plan + tests)

Hi all  quick internal notes and POC logistics: 

1) Aditya: confirmed I'll own infra setup for both hosted and VPC. I'll provision a VPC test cluster in us-west-2 and mirror the prompt distributions Sophie will send.
2) Tests we'll run (initial run next Wed/Thu):
   - Latency profile: p50/p95/p99 for each intent at 2k qps (ramp 0->2k over 10 minutes).
   - Cost sim: synthetic token mix to compare per-token unit economics across Redwood, CloudGen, InferX.
   - Logging/retention verification: export logs into S3 and verify NDJSON format and 365-day retention lifecycle.
3) Deliverables before kickoff: 
   - Aditya: calendar invites + PoC playbook (today).
   - Connor: infra provisioning + baseline script (by Tue EOD).
   - Marissa: competitive teardown doc (Redwood vs CloudGen vs InferX) focusing on routing, batching capabilities, quantization options (by Tue EOD).

Marissa  tagging you for the teardown doc and any notes from last week's competitive tests you want to include.

Connor O'Brien
